facts.note: Seventeen blocks west to east: the barrow field inside its two dykes, fifteen across, and the dykes themselves.
Twenty-nine blocks north to south: from the foot of the keep wall, down the grave road past the shore fire, to the line the tide leaves.
Eighteen blocks of barrow field from the keep gate to the beach: the bier in the middle, the grave row along one side, graves on both flanks.
